caution_findings.evidence_context: Some DBAASP rows store species-level Pseudomonas aeruginosa where the source table row is the PA-OS ocular clinical isolate; row-level locators preserve the source target.
DBAASP names LL-37 fragments by residue interval, while the paper names the same sequences FK13 and FK16.
DBAASP categorical 10-20% hemolysis for FK16 is supported by the exact paper value 13.61 ± 3.29% at 256 µg/mL.
